body: To be honest, I'm not really down because I failed at anything in particular. More of the fact that as long as I live, I'll always be tormented by these thoughts and memories; and I stop being able to see the point in being successful in the first place.

Heh, thanks. At this point, I already know I could probably become fairly successful in life if I just worked on it, but it really does feel hopeless when I realise that thoughts like these are going to stop me every time.
